sources.title: Character.ai: CAI-Image family (Sep 16)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Character.ai Sep 16 launches CAI-Image family: own image models post-trained from open-source Qwen-Image for character-driven storytelling (Comics, Imagine surfaces); vendor positioning of speed/cost/control trinity at million-user scale.
claims.context: Post lede and rationale as stated.

claims.text: Four trained areas: style range/transfer (named styles, palettes, image references incl. cross-subject); multi-character scenes + pose control (multi-image single generation); cinematic camera control (245 natural-language positions: 5x7x7); dedicated manga/comics page model (panels, accurate text, emotion, frame-to-frame continuity; 100+ page community works). CAI-MM-Studio full-stack (data, multi-node training, scoring-model eval, serving). Next: V2 environments/emotion/layout + Animate Comics video step.

limitations.text: Side-by-side comparisons vs strongest open/closed models are vendor-presented visuals without reproducible methodology.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Training-data, serving-cost, and quality figures vendor-described.
